design: identical StratifiedGroupKFold split across arms; each bootstrap replicate resamples subjects once and scores both arms on that same resample

delta_b_minus_a_auroc.p_two_sided_note: 0 of 1000 replicates reverse sign, so the bootstrap p is below the resolution of the replicate count. The manuscript reports p < 0.002 (= 2/1000), which is the smallest value this design can support.
